paragraphs.text: Leviathans are immense whale -like creatures that aren't necessarily found in the water. Most leviathans feature extraordinarily large mouths that could seemingly swallow the sea or the sky.

They are not to be confused with krakens . The distinction between the two is rather vague. In general, leviathans tend to resemble mammals or reptiles, while krakens often combine aspects of mollusks, crustaceans, and fish.
The first card to bear the creature type was Segovian Leviathan from Legends .

There are two kinds of leviathans on Alara : The Esperite version is a near-mythical creature who is rumored to have devoured the seventh sea of the shard. Another is found near Kederekt on Grixis . With the reunification of Alara, some of these leviathans have wandered into their adjacent shards.

The Leviathans of Avishkar are at home in the aethersphere of the plane and resemble enormous eels. Similar to whales , they filter out their prey from the aether currents, although most leviathans also swallow drakes, skyships, and similar smaller objects.
In the Mer Empire civil war, Empress Llawan led her own personal leviathan into battle.

Nicol Bolas once fought against a demonic leviathan in the first duel between planeswalkers on the still-young plane of Dominaria . The fight lasted a month, reduced Madara to a third of its original size, and created the first spatial rift . After his victory, Bolas feasted on the remains of the leviathan over the course of a year, absorbing its power in the process. When he finished, not much was left besides what eventually became known as the Talon Gates and an assortment of blubber.

The Leviathans found on Mirrodin were likely transported there via Memnarch 's soul traps . Like all life on that plane, they had metallic features. Memnarch used them together with his Levelers against the organic civilizations.

The Simic created several predatory leviathans that were airborne, like the Nimbus Swimmer and the Sky Swallower , through selective breeding. These skyswimmers feed on drakes , rocs , griffins and anything else they can catch.

The natural species that evolved naturally on the seafloor and in deep-trench caves are known as benthids . Some are so vast that they can't fit through the zonot apertures and are therefore trapped below.
Segovia is a plane where everything exists in miniature. The Segovian Leviathan is the largest creature on the plane. However, it is about the size of a Dominarian elephant .
In the original timeline of Tarkir , a single leviathan was known to exist within the mountainous seas. Its fate in the current timeline is unknown.

Leviathans in the Edge patrol outer space instead of oceans. They are uniquely aligned wi th green mana instead of blue . While most exist on a cosmic scale, a few are small enough to slumber beneath the icy surface of Evendo .
